methods.contacts: Every actual base vertex ray parity inside assigned closed parent using three oblique rays, majority vote; exact near-surface epsilon allowed. No fitted/config points.
methods.exposure: Every actual component vertex plus every triangle centroid raycast in eight directions against all OTHER component triangles. Not a screen-space pass gate; pixel inspection separate.
methods.topology: Raw unchanged source triangle index edge use. Signed triangle integral is not called physical volume for open surfaces.
